items.stem: What does the Municipal Divisions page maintain?

options.text: The city-provided set of communities, quadrants, and cities (and their supplemental data) that schools service
The parent/child roll-up of communities into quadrants and cities
The list of staff job assignments for each division
The Attendance Area maps for each school

items.explanation: Municipal Divisions maintains the municipal division records — the city-provided communities/quadrants/cities and their supplemental data — that schools will be servicing.

misconceptions.b: That's the Municipal Division Hierarchy page; the records page holds the divisions themselves.
misconceptions.c: Job assignments belong to Staff, not Municipal Divisions.
misconceptions.d: Attendance Area maps are a separate entity, not municipal divisions.

items.stem: What does the Municipal Division Hierarchy page maintain?

options.text: The parent/child relationships — how communities roll up into quadrants and cities
The city-provided list of community records and their supplemental data
The AAD security groups that grant editing rights
The SMTP settings used for on-hold job notifications

items.explanation: The hierarchy page maintains the parent/child relationships between municipal divisions: communities rolling up into quadrants and cities. It also provides the link to associate the communities a school services.

misconceptions.b: Maintaining the records themselves is the Municipal Divisions page's job.
misconceptions.c: Editing rights are governed by Data Owners, not the hierarchy page.
misconceptions.d: Notification settings are unrelated to the municipal division hierarchy.

items.stem: You need to record that several communities roll up into a particular quadrant. Which page do you use?

options.text: Municipal Division Hierarchy
Municipal Divisions
Schools
Standalone Groups

items.explanation: Roll-up (parent/child) relationships — communities into quadrants and cities — are maintained on the Municipal Division Hierarchy page.

misconceptions.b: The Municipal Divisions page maintains the division records, not the roll-up between them.
misconceptions.c: The Schools page augments schools; it isn't where the division roll-up is set.
misconceptions.d: Standalone Groups are hand-maintained membership lists, unrelated to division roll-up.

items.stem: Where do you associate the specific communities that a given school services?

options.text: Via the link provided on the Municipal Division Hierarchy page
By creating a new municipal division record for the school
In the AuditLog entry for the school
By editing the school's name field in HRAD

items.explanation: The Municipal Division Hierarchy page provides a link to associate the communities a school services.

misconceptions.b: You associate existing communities; you don't create a division per school.
misconceptions.c: The AuditLog records changes; it isn't an association surface.
misconceptions.d: The school's HRAD fields are unrelated to which communities it services.

items.stem: In the municipal division hierarchy, what is the roll-up order?

options.text: Communities roll up into quadrants and cities
Cities roll up into quadrants and communities
Quadrants roll up into communities
Schools roll up into communities

items.explanation: The hierarchy maintains communities rolling up into quadrants and cities — communities are the children, quadrants and cities the parents.

misconceptions.b: The direction is reversed: communities are the smallest unit rolling up, not cities.
misconceptions.c: Quadrants don't roll up into communities; communities roll up into quadrants.
misconceptions.d: Schools service communities; they aren't a level of the division hierarchy.

items.stem: In one or two sentences, explain how the Municipal Divisions page and the Municipal Division Hierarchy page differ, and name one thing the hierarchy page lets you do beyond setting roll-up.
rubric: States Municipal Divisions maintains the city-provided division records (communities/quadrants/cities) and their supplemental data
States Municipal Division Hierarchy maintains the parent/child roll-up — communities into quadrants and cities
Names the extra capability: a link to associate the communities a school services
items.sampleAnswer: Municipal Divisions maintains the city-provided community/quadrant/city records and their supplemental data, while Municipal Division Hierarchy maintains how those communities roll up into quadrants and cities. The hierarchy page also provides a link to associate the communities a school services.
